purpose: Teach: 前線/最前線/対峙/誹謗/出頭/無垢/撃た/説く

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時下の、前線の兵士、論文で、本当に、丁寧に、扱われていましたね、感動的な、内容でした、私、読んで、心が、揺さぶられました、本当に。
lines.en: Ren — your paper on wartime front-line soldiers was handled with such care. The content was deeply moving. I found myself genuinely shaken while reading it.
lines.style: Warm, measured opening. Slight pause after his name. Soft emphasis on 「care」 and 「shaken」. Steady eye contact, speaking from genuine reflection. The cadence of someone choosing words that matter.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。記録の最前線、当時の従軍記者、本当に、命を、かけて、報じていました、論文で、丁寧に、論じました、本当に、感動的な、研究、できました。
lines.en: Thank you. The war correspondents of that era — they risked their lives reporting from the front lines. I tried to discuss their work carefully in the paper. It was genuinely moving research to do.
lines.style: Humble but direct. Slight quickening as he warms to the topic. Honest gratitude beneath the formality. A small intake of breath before naming the stakes — 「they risked their lives」 — then steadies. Soft but sincere.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦争で、文化が、対峙した場面、論文で、本当に、深く、論じられていますね、桜さん、視点、本当に、独創的でしたね、研究の質、本当に、立派でした。
lines.en: The way the paper examined how culture confronted war — you developed that so deeply. Your perspective was really original, and the quality of the research was genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly slower pace. Genuine warmth beneath professional composure. Leaning slightly forward on 「original」. No flattery — this is careful observation being shared. Trails slightly at the end, inviting response.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦中の誹謗、対立する民族間で、深刻でしたね、論文で、扱いました、現代の、社会問題にも、繋がる、テーマでした、本当に、研究、深かった、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. The wartime slander and conflict between ethnic groups was severe — that's what I examined in the paper. It's a theme that connects to modern social issues too. The research went quite deep.
lines.style: Measured, building slowly. Small pause before naming the difficult subjects. Serious but not heavy. The pace steadies as he moves from wartime to its modern echo. Ends with quiet conviction, not defensiveness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦犯の出頭、戦後の歴史で、本当に、重要な、転換点でしたね、論文の中で、扱われていましたね、本当に、深い研究、桜さん、評価できますよ、本当に。
lines.en: The surrender of war criminals — that was truly a turning point in postwar history, wasn't it? You handled that in the paper with real depth. I think your work here deserves genuine recognition, Ren.
lines.style: Direct and warm. Slightly more animated than before — she's building to something important. Clear articulation of 「turning point」. Ends with weight: his name is said with finality and respect, not as an afterthought.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦争の犠牲者、無垢な、市民の方々、本当に、多かったですね、論文で、丁寧に、扱いました、本当に、心が、痛む、研究内容でした、私にとっても、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. There were so many innocent civilians who suffered as victims of war. I wanted to handle their stories carefully in the paper. It was painful research to sit with — for me, it really was.
lines.style: Quieter now. The pace slows. Small, deliberate pauses before 「innocent civilians」 and before admitting his own pain. His voice carries the weight of what he's described. Not breaking, but clearly affected. Vulnerable without seeking comfort.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦争で、撃たれた市民の方々、本当に、たくさん、いらっしゃいましたよね、論文の中で、丁寧に、論じていましたね、感動的な、扱いでした、本当に、立派でした。
lines.en: So many civilians were shot during the war. The way you examined that in your paper — with such care and depth — it was genuinely moving work. You should be very proud of it.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective. Slower pace throughout. Slight tremor of emotion held steady. Speaking with the care of someone honoring difficult subjects. Each phrase deliberate. Ends softly but with conviction — not rushed, not withdrawn.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。平和を、説く言葉、戦後の、人々から、たくさん、いただきました、論文の重要な、視点でした、本当に、感謝、しております、お話、聞かせていただいて。
lines.en: Thank you. After the war, the survivors and those who came after — they left us with so many words about peace. That became a central lens for my paper. I'm truly grateful you took the time to discuss this with me.
lines.style: Softer, almost tender closing. Slight catch on 「grateful」 — genuine, not performative. Slower pace, as if each word is being carefully placed. Trails very slightly at the end, accepting the conversation's natural close. Humble gratitude made concrete.
